# The paths a pull request may change only with the orchestrator's word on its head: a commit
# status orchestrator/word on that exact sha (#3917 A3). One Python regex a line, searched for
# anywhere in each changed file's path (re.search), so a regex without ^ matches inside a path, as
# host\.h$ does. A renamed file counts as its old path and its new one.
# .github/scripts/merge-train.py reads this file from main's tree, never from a pull request's,
# and it's under .github/, so a change to it needs the word too. core/ and engine/ aren't here:
# they're never a train's.
^\.github/
^AGENTS\.md$
^CONTRIBUTING\.md$
^docs/decisions\.md$
^tools/
^app/build\.sh$
^app/setup\.sh$
^app/check\.sh$
# A run's file is shared once a second run sources it, so all of check/ is gated.
^app/check/
^app/patches/gpui-.*\.patch$
^app/platform/
host\.h$
# Agent code: the agents' tools, their permission rules (app/src/agents.rs) and what they may
# reach, and the agents' UI, wherever it is under app/src.
^app/src/.*agent
# The MCP bridge and the ilo command, app/Cargo.toml's mcp-bridge and ilo-command binaries.
^app/src/bridge\.rs$
^app/src/ilo_command\.rs$
